description: This source file defines an Android Activity named ListViewItemAnimations, which demonstrates swipe-to-delete functionality with animations for list items in a ListView. It includes touch handling, swipe animations, and item removal with animated transitions.

classes.name: ListViewItemAnimations
classes.description: An Android Activity demonstrating swipe-to-delete with animations in a ListView.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the adapter for the ListView, and links UI components.

methods.name: isRuntimePostGingerbread
methods.description: Checks whether the Android runtime is Gingerbread or later based on SDK version.

methods.name: mTouchListener.onTouch
methods.description: Handles touch events on list items for swipe detection and initiates swipe animations.

methods.name: animateSwipe
methods.description: Animates the swipe action of a list item, either removing it or restoring it to position.

methods.name: setSwipePosition
methods.description: Sets the current swipe position and transparency of a list item during swiping.

methods.name: animateOtherViews
methods.description: Animates remaining list items into their proper positions after an item removal.

methods.name: moveView
methods.description: Animates a view from one position to another, supporting different API levels.

methods.name: setAnimatorEndAction
methods.description: Attaches an end action callback to an animator.

methods.name: setAnimationEndAction
methods.description: Attaches an end action callback to an animation.
